reviews.review: I used this for the first time before a beach trip. I downloaded it a week before and I would have forgotten almost half the stuff I need to pack! reviews.title: This app is amazing!
reviews.review: By the way I write this review I am going to seem like a bit but, but I can assure you I am not, I just love this app so much!!There are in app purchases (as most apps have) however, unlike other apps, these purchase choices do not get in the way. You do not NEED them to use the app. I am going on a trip soon and this is the first time i have used this app to plan my packing. Now, after using it for just one trip, I know i will be using it for every trip from now on. It suggests things that you may need
